name: shopify-to-kc-price-changes-tool
description: PHP pipeline that syncs Shopify variant price changes (via Matrixify CSV) to a KC pricelist.
summary: This tool helps sync product variant price changes from Shopify to the Khaos Control (KC) system by importing Shopify price data, identifying real price changes, and exporting actionable updates. It is designed for operations teams managing product pricing, ensuring only meaningful price updates are sent to KC, reducing errors and manual work. The tool automates tracking and exporting price additions, updates, or deletions based on recent Shopify data compared to the KC pricelist.
